title: rhamnus frangula var. pumila
intro: Rhamnus frangula var. pumila, commonly known as Dwarf Alder Buckthorn, is a plant species that is a smaller variant of the Rhamnus frangula plant. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as a natural laxative, due to its high concentration of anthraquinone glycosides. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Alder Buckthorn include stimulating bowel movements, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. Its bioactive constituents include anthraquinone glycosides, such as rhein, emodin, and aloe-emodin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
